class.name: HTMLPointerEvent
class.brief_description: A pointer event for mouse and touch input.
class.description: Pointer events report a stable pointer ID and a type of [code]mouse[/code], [code]pen[/code], or [code]touch[/code]. [HTMLLabel] synthesizes mouse and touch pointer events. Touch pointer IDs remain stable for each device and touch index pair. When Godot emulates mouse input from touch, [HTMLLabel] uses that mouse input instead of also dispatching touch pointer events. A touch pointer receives [code]pointercancel[/code] when viewport scrolling takes over the gesture or the touch is canceled. Call [method HTMLElement.set_pointer_capture] from an active pointer handler to keep subsequent pointer events targeted at an element. Move events are coalesced per frame.

members.member: The ID for this pointer. Mouse events use [code]0[/code], while a touch keeps the same ID for its device and touch index pair.
Whether this is the primary pointer of its type.
